title: The items nice, long
text:
The items nice, long. Normally i dont complain much, but the photo shown has 2 tassles... The description sais nothing about 1-2... But reality you get 1 tassel for what reason someone would need 1 not 2 is beyond me.. But updated photo and description goes along way when people are ordering items for the room to finish off minor details...

Now beside the lack of updated info and picture.. The items nice, long, and well made for the buck.
